# sprint issues get

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../../README.md) · [Parent](../issues.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint issues get — Read permitted records

SYNOPSIS
  sprint issues get ID [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Read permitted records

EXAMPLES
  sprint issues get SPR-123 --non-interactive

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  ID

FLAGS
  No command-specific flags.

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output {data} on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  UUID, current key and old aliases resolve to one issue. Archive/restore/move-team require --expected-revision; history reads the same authorized issue; --include-deleted explicitly reads retained deleted history under current project permission and does not restore deleted issues. Create/update accept --title, --team, --project, --assignee, --sprint and --estimate alongside JSON/file only when fields do not overlap. Daily create defaults status todo and priority 보통 and generates one operation key unless supplied; stdout/stderr operationKey metadata preserves it for explicit retry. Daily update reads the authorized issue once for its revision unless --expected-revision is supplied unchanged; no automatic refresh or mutation retry. Legacy JSON/file-only headers remain optional. Archive/restore/move-team accept optional --operation-key for receipt replay. --all exhausts list/history pages and fails on changed, repeated or incomplete results; --non-interactive never prompts. issues list --archived true selects archived issues. Deletes retain legacy permanent removal semantics and require linked children to be removed first. Responses include local sync state not-enrolled until enrolled. Safe structured server error fields remain on stderr.
```
